glass.litEdge: Top ~22% of a pane carries the edge color fading out.
glass.rule: Glass only where content passes beneath: app bar (once scrolled under), capture bar, navigation pane, editor side sheet. Never glass on glass.
glass.room: Soft vertical gradient plus fixed lavender (left middle) and mint (floor) lights and the peach lamp that moves per project over 900ms easeInOutCubic; still under reduced motion.
glass.listCard: Open list in one DecoratedSliver card: pane tint, 1px border, 24px radius, soft shadow by day only, no blur.

captureLayout.normal: Floats over the list end, 12px inset, max 760px, above the safe area; the list measures it and pads its end so the last task scrolls clear.
captureLayout.compact: Above tasks in the shared CustomScrollView; the app bar is a single non-pinned row.
captureLayout.state: GlobalKey preserves draft across layout moves. Pending submission disables duplicate sends; draft revision tracks text and priority edits, so success clears only the unchanged submitted draft and failure preserves it.
captureLayout.send: At least 48px in both dimensions in all states; opacity changes from 0.55 to 1 over quick motion, without scaling the target.

extensions.implementation: Flutter Material 3; lib/app/palette.dart (FarashPalette.dew) is the single color source, priorities included; neutrals generated from a violet seed. Panel snippets are illustrative; OKLCH ramps are inspection aids rather than shipping tokens. Panel component snippets demonstrate the dark dew palette; day variants use the day frontmatter tokens.

editorLayout.wide: Full-height 400px side sheet at the end edge, a single glass pane.
editorLayout.narrow: Modal bottom sheet on the solid sheet surface, keyboard-aware.
editorLayout.actions: Fixed action row: delete icon at the start, primary save at the end.
editorLayout.propertyRow: Nonexpanding property heading stacks above control when available width <480px.
editorLayout.priority: Minimum 48x48px targets; vertical when width <320px and textScaler.scale(14)>18.

appBar.pattern: Material 3 medium top app bar as a SliverPersistentHeader
appBar.titles: Large Naskh title with mark and open count fades out over the first 60% of collapse; the toolbar title fades in after, so one title exists at a time.

todayStrip.content: Open tasks due today, late count and planned time; hidden when the day is clear.

extensions.datePills: Today, tomorrow and overdue use 14% of their role color: translucent by day, composited over solid surface at night to insulate labels from room blooms; radius 99px, padding 2px 8px. Later dates remain plain.
extensions.contrastEvidence: Widget/source tests cover named text roles on solid surface and base glass over backdrop stops, sheet body roles, priority marks, and rendered tomorrow pills over sampled individual bloom composites. They do not prove all text roles over every ambient overlap. No Android hardware or accessibility-service validation claimed.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The one primary action of a view (save, send): night violet on violet ink.

components.name: Secondary Text Action
components.description: Add checklist, add subtask: ink, never violet.

components.name: Glass Pane
components.description: A frosted pane (blur 20, 10% night white tint (62% by day), 1px light border, lit top edge) used once per region where content passes beneath.

components.name: Capture Field
components.description: The capture bar: one glass pane holding the field, priority menu and filled send; violet edge while focused. Send has a fixed minimum 48px target and opacity-only readiness feedback.

components.name: Done Stamp
components.description: Pressed onto a checked row before it folds; nothing vanishes unannounced.

components.name: Date Labels
components.description: Today violet, tomorrow mint, later muted, overdue rose. Night pills composite the 14% role tint over #1C1834; day pills keep a translucent tint.

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar project row; selection is a night tone, not the primary accent.

components.name: Project App Bar
components.description: Material 3 medium top app bar: large Naskh project title with mark and open count, collapsing into a 64px toolbar whose glass fades in once tasks scroll beneath.

narrative.overview: Three soft lights (a peach lamp that moves with the project, lavender across the room and mint near the floor) behind white frosted glass by day, and the same hues low in a violet night. Plain Material 3 structure: a medium top app bar naming the project, a today strip with real counts, the open list in one glass card, a floating capture bar, a drawer or navigation pane, and the editor as a side or bottom sheet.
keyCharacteristics: Three lights behind the glass: peach lamp, lavender and mint.
The open list in one glass card; never glass on glass.
Medium top app bar naming the project in Naskh.
Today strip with real counts only.
Violet now, mint tomorrow, rose overdue, near dates in tinted pills.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Violet is spent only on now: today, the today strip, the done stamp, the focused capture edge and the one primary action.

rules.name: The Single Pane Rule
rules.body: One pane of glass per region; a pane never contains another pane, a field box or a card.

rules.name: The Persian Reading Rule
rules.body: RTL and directional spacing everywhere; account email isolated LTR.

rules.name: The Reachable Control Rule
rules.body: Every action target is at least 48px.

dos: Take every color from FarashPalette.dew, priorities included.
Use glass only where content passes beneath it, with light behind it.
Name the current project in the app bar on every width.
Edit in a side sheet on wide screens and a modal bottom sheet on phones.
donts: Nest glass in glass or box a field inside a pane.
Frame the whole phone screen in a pane.
Float the editor as a short card inside the list.
Add texture patterns to the glass.
Add eyebrow labels or tiny floating labels over the editor title.
Spend violet on secondary actions, icons or selection.
